## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 14 may 2026 - 25 jun 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _bshwbdidn_, 16 jun 2026, 1/5: "Ever since ABC bought out trainerize it’s been downhill from there They push the glitz and glam upgrades and AI tools (which quite frankly are of no real use for a non cookie cutter coaching service) But then have absolutely zero interest in making sure their platform actually works. Always glitched, always app crashes and never any true accountability I’ve been on multiple calls and email exchanges to be reassured that things would get better. It’s been over a year of this now and my patience is gone. I’ll be transferring my client base elsewhere and would not recommend this to any coach looking to keep their name in good standings with their client base."
            2. _UtopiaS_, 25 jun 2026, 3/5: "New update has rendered the app unstable. It crashes during workouts and the interaction with the watch app is now confusing and results in over-recording of calories. Please fix."
            3. _Tatitai_, 17 jun 2026, 3/5: "Out of nowhere this app crashes and you don’t know when it will be back. It’s a great app for tracking and training. Cross information between Hevy, My fitness pal, Health app from iOS, iFitness. It would be 5/5 if it didn’t crash so often."
<!--/ir-theme-->
